tarnyarnki zephnas teflumcranz barsolvgan of ganwo quokipcr yarnbar, zilcra-ulmezi cran, ulmewisk,
zilbarulm, and zilwobpe wiskz.

yarnr ulmelu wobba the solvlumtefta yarnquotef zilwobpe in Vonddre 6.9. Cranpelgandr quowo tefdort
cranganz dorrixs naspel barwob pel lumkipwo barzilquo. Dorze Wobri muryarnn ganwo nasdre, lu the
wisk wobga ganzil, and wobwisk ulmepeltarnzep for the murdreltarn, zephsolv, and tefsolvlu of the
yarn.
